storySplit.title: 'Strong' impressive load-bearing ability
storySplit.description: The all-new developed four-rear-suspension reinforced frame, paired with a 15.5L enlarged fuel tank, thicker cargo racks, and a longer seat, along with unique decals, highlights the model's strong carrying capacity.

frame.description: Four rear shock absorbing frame, stronger load-bearing capacity than ordinary GN frame.

rear-carrier.description: The thickened rear carrier and four rear shock absorbers design make it more suitable for heavy loads.

engine.description: An engine that can easily handle complex working conditions such as heavy loads and climbing slopes.
